description: Merge two or more PDF files into one, in the order given. Runs entirely on this machine — the file is read and written locally and never sent anywhere.

force.description: Replace the output file if it already exists (default: refuse, so existing files are never silently clobbered)

inputs.description: Paths to the input PDFs, in merge order (2 or more)

output.description: Path to write the merged PDF

name: pdf_merge
title: Merge PDFs
